source_observations.finding: cmd_hook parses the full hook JSON and forwards the PreToolUse payload to zulassen(data) and the PostToolUse payload to merken(data).

Exact token search over the pinned stern.py blob found zero occurrences of tool_use_id and zero occurrences of agent_id. The hook payload is forwarded, but those native identities are not explicitly modeled by this versioned source.
zulassen()/merken() document their PreToolUse->PostToolUse correlation through active_turns.effect_id, explicitly described as a session-bound single field.

The current selftest payload for PreToolUse/PostToolUse contains tool_name, tool_input and tool_response but no tool_use_id. Therefore this selftest can remain green while call-scoped invocation identity is absent or cross-wired.

architecture_refinement.contract: WorkExecutionBinding/v2 + EffectInvocationIdentity/v1 share the same immutable call-scoped identity boundary.
causal_chain: target lifecycle agent_id when observed and normalized
architecture_refinement.identity_rule: tool_use_id is the primary hook-call correlation key whenever the host supplies it; session_id is context only and active_turns.effect_id must not remain the sole primary correlation pointer for potentially overlapping calls.
architecture_refinement.package_rule: paket_id must be deterministically bound to the exact Agent spawn tool_use_id before or at invocation; timestamp, description similarity, session order and completion order are forbidden join substitutes.
architecture_refinement.lifecycle_rule: Do not collapse Agent PostToolUse tool_response.agentId and SubagentStart/SubagentStop agent_id into one canonical identity until target-runtime evidence establishes their equality/normalization relation for the installed build.
architecture_refinement.task_rule: task_id remains an optional independent task-system namespace and is not an agent_id alias.
architecture_refinement.sparse_world_rule: These identities are causal provenance, not world facts. Sparse WorldSlice/WorldNeed structures may reference bound receipts but must not synthesize a missing identity edge.

required_regressions_for_triggerword4: Add a distinct tool_use_id to every synthetic PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook fixture.
Add same-session A/B interleaving: Pre(A), Pre(B), Post(A), Post(B); A and B must update only their own invocation/effect records.
Add reverse completion order: Pre(A), Pre(B), Post(B), Post(A); correlation must remain exact.
Add missing-tool_use_id fail-closed behavior at any effect-authority boundary that requires exact invocation attribution.
For Agent delegation, test paket_id -> Agent tool_use_id -> response agentId with two concurrent delegated calls and prove no cross-wire.
Keep runtime-host lifecycle equality as a separate acceptance gate; repository unit tests must not manufacture target-host runtime credit.
counterhypothesis: The installed runtime may serialize relevant calls strongly enough that the current single session pointer does not mis-correlate in one observed version. That would bound a current runtime race but would not validate the present selftest or justify discarding the stronger documented tool_use_id contract for Frankenstein 2.0.
falsifier: A deterministic repository regression that exercises same-session interleaving with unique tool_use_id values and shows exact independent Pre/Post correlation closes the source-level identity-test gap. Installed-host behavior remains a separate Triggerword-4 runtime gate.
next_exact_gate: Triggerword 4 implements call-scoped tool_use_id persistence/correlation plus the A/B interleaving regressions, then under an explicitly admitted target-runtime lane captures one harmless Agent PostToolUse and SubagentStart/SubagentStop sequence to verify the installed identity normalization.
